# Design System — Extended

## Overview

**Identity:** Milligram Minimalist Design System
**Summary:** A lightweight, minimalist UI design system emphasizing whitespace, purple accent highlights, subtle gray tones, and sharp typography.
**Density:** spacious
**Layout philosophy:** Clean, centered grid layout with strong typographic vertical rhythm and minimal decorative chrome.

### Tone and personality

- clean
- minimal
- modern
- lightweight
- functional
- unobtrusive
- approachable

## Tokens — Colors

### Brand

| Name | Value | Role | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `primary-purple` | `#9b4dca` | Primary actions, branding highlights, accent links | detected; 0.95; web_2 |
| `bootstrap-blue` | `#0d6efd` | Secondary primary blue CTA buttons | detected; 0.90; web_1 |

### Accent

| Name | Value | Role | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `light-blue` | `#5485b2` | Secondary action button or link state | detected; 0.80; web_2 |

### Surfaces

| Name | Value | Role | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bg-white` | `#ffffff` | Primary background surface | detected; 0.95; web_2 |
| `bg-light-gray` | `#f4f5f6` | Code blocks, callouts, light card backgrounds | detected; 0.90; web_2 |
| `bg-dark-hero` | `#212529` | Dark hero surface background | detected; 0.85; web_1 |

### Text

| Name | Value | Role | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text-main` | `#606c76` | Body paragraph text | detected; 0.95; web_2 |
| `text-heading` | `#000000` | Headings and high-contrast text | detected; 0.90; web_2 |
| `text-muted` | `#6c757d` | Subtitles, secondary labels | detected; 0.85; web_1 |

### Borders

| Name | Value | Role | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `border-light` | `#d1d1d1` | Card borders, input outlines | detected; 0.90; web_2 |
| `border-dark` | `#495057` | Dark theme dividers | detected; 0.80; web_1 |

### Gradients

| Name | Value | Role | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

## Tokens — Typography

### Families

- `font-sans`: Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif — Primary body and heading typography (detected, confidence 0.95; source: web_2)
- `font-mono`: monospace, monospace — Code snippet typography (detected, confidence 0.95; source: web_2)

### Type Scale

- `heading-xl`: no measurable values — Hero main heading
- `body-regular`: no measurable values — Standard paragraph text

### Principles

- Light weight base typography (300 weight)
- Generous line height for readable copy
- Clean monospaced formatting for technical code snippets

### Open-source substitutes

- Inter
- Roboto
- System UI

## Tokens — Spacing & Shapes

### Spacing

**Base unit:** 8px

- `spacing-xs`: 4px — Tight element spacing (inferred, confidence 0.85; source: web_2)
- `spacing-sm`: 8px — Compact margin/padding (inferred, confidence 0.85; source: web_2)
- `spacing-md`: 16px — Standard gap (inferred, confidence 0.85; source: web_2)
- `spacing-lg`: 24px — Section margin bottom (inferred, confidence 0.85; source: web_2)
- `spacing-xl`: 40px — Hero section vertical padding (inferred, confidence 0.85; source: web_2)

**Section padding**

- `section-padding-y`: 75px — Vertical padding between page sections (detected, confidence 0.90; source: web_2)

**Card padding**


**Button padding**

- `button-padding-md`: 8px — Standard button vertical padding (detected, confidence 0.90; source: web_2)

### Border radius

- `radius-sm`: 4px — Standard button and input corner rounding (detected, confidence 0.95; source: web_2)
- `radius-md`: 6px — Card corner rounding (detected, confidence 0.85; source: web_1)

### Photography geometry


### Aspect ratios


**Cropping:** Uncropped rectangular images with standard corner radius options.

## Components

### button-primary

Main call-to-action filled button

- `bg-color`: #9b4dca — Background color (detected, confidence 0.95; source: web_2)
- `text-color`: #ffffff — Label color (detected, confidence 0.95; source: web_2)
- `border-radius`: 4px — Corner rounding (detected, confidence 0.95; source: web_2)


### button-outline

Secondary stroked action button

- `bg-color`: transparent — Background color (detected, confidence 0.90; source: web_2)
- `text-color`: #9b4dca — Label color (detected, confidence 0.90; source: web_2)
- `border-color`: #9b4dca — Border tint (detected, confidence 0.90; source: web_2)


## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Use purple accent colors sparingly for high priority CTAs.
- Keep layout spacious with light light gray backgrounds for code blocks.
- Maintain crisp monospaced fonts for technical command examples.

### Don't

- Do not clutter surfaces with dark box-shadow gradients.
- Avoid heavy text font weights in body paragraphs.
- Do not mix multiple competing accent bright colors simultaneously.

## Surfaces


**Philosophy:** Simple light theme dominated by stark white backgrounds with light gray contrast areas for code documentation.

## Elevation


### Borders


**Philosophy:** Flat visual design approach with minimal drop shadows, relying on light surface color shifts and clean hairline borders.

## Imagery


**Visual language:** Minimalist screenshots with crisp rectangular frames showing web app interfaces.
**Photography:** Clean digital browser mockups and code preview banners.
**Iconography:** Simple vector outline icon elements.

## Layout

### Layout values

- `max-width-container`: 1120px — Maximum content width limit (inferred, confidence 0.80; source: web_2)

### Container


### Grid and gutters


**Whitespace philosophy:** Extensive padding and margins create an uncluttered, open presentation focused on readable typography.

## Responsive Behavior

### Breakpoints

- `breakpoint-sm`: 576px — Small screens (detected, confidence 0.90; source: web_1)
- `breakpoint-md`: 768px — Medium screens (detected, confidence 0.90; source: web_1)
- `breakpoint-lg`: 992px — Large screens (detected, confidence 0.90; source: web_1)

### Touch targets


### Layout changes


### Image behavior

- Fluid responsive scaling within parent container columns.

## Iteration Guide

- To extend this framework, maintain strict adherence to light surface contrast ratios and simple 4px rounded shapes.

## Known Gaps

- `MISSING_SHADOWS`: No explicit box-shadow tokens detected in primary web_2 source. (source: web_2)
- `UNRESOLVED_TYPOGRAPHY_METRICS`: Exact line heights and letter spacings for heading levels not fully resolved to single pixel values. (source: web_2)
- `css-variables-unavailable`: No accessible CSS custom properties were captured from this source. (source: web_2)
- `capture-height-truncated`: The page exceeded the screenshot height limit; lower-page evidence may be missing. (source: web_2)

## Agent Prompt Guide

- Build layouts centered around minimal container widths with high contrast Roboto headers and monospaced snippets.

## Similar Brands

- `skeleton-css`: Skeleton CSS — Minimal CSS framework (interpreted, confidence 0.80; source: web_2)
- `pure-css`: Pure.css — Unobtrusive modular CSS module (interpreted, confidence 0.80; source: web_2)

## Quick Start

- Include Roboto and Monospace fonts, set background to #ffffff, body text to #606c76, and primary buttons to #9b4dca.

## Evidence

- `web_1` — analyzed, weight 25: https://getbootstrap.com/docs/5.3/examples/heroes/
- `web_2` — analyzed, weight 75: http://milligram.io/
